Step 3. The trace-class operator \(B_{01270013}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle B_{01270013} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through Wavelet approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
